## Feature Proposal
A clear and concise description of what feature you are proposing.

## Motivation & Research Context
How does this feature support the central PRISM mission of probing and comparing visual representations across learning paradigms?

## Proposed Implementation / Architecture
Describe how this feature fits into PRISM package boundaries (e.g. `prism.models`, `prism.representations`, `prism.robustness`).

## Research Contract Compliance
- How will fairness across baselines be preserved?
- What are the compute / parameter considerations?
